classification.interpretation: The retained source population contains repeated direct pUSD cash receipts across BTC ETH and SOL complete-set holdings. This is the only accepted scope with multi-asset recurring direct-cash evidence; it is still historical public-wallet evidence rather than owned-account deployment proof.

These scopes add yield only to independently existing idle inventory or already-required collateral. Public rates or historical indices can be positive, but account eligibility, exact current rates, principal risks, alternative yield and external costs remain incomplete.

These scopes can reduce costs or add rebates only when legitimate trading borrowing conversion or loan activity already exists independently. They are not standalone profit generators and must never justify manufacturing activity.
These scopes require authentic external users readers clients referrals or followers. They are distribution or business revenue overlays, not autonomous market-profit edges.

decision.why: Accepted-edge count is a scope ledger, not a profitability score. Only one accepted scope has retained multi-asset recurring direct-cash evidence. Every scope still lacks some combination of current account qualification, complete external costs, new-capital opportunity cost, persistence or deployment authority.

definitions.account_qualified: The exact account is currently eligible and the exact applicable rate capacity balance lineage and cost state are source-bound.
definitions.after_all_cost: Direct fees gas spread slippage funding conversion unwind delay failure tax custody operating cost and the best feasible alternative use of capital are all included.
definitions.recurring_direct_cash: Repeated source-bound cash or cash-equivalent reward transfers, excluding imputed inventory value, advertised rates and acceptance predicates that require future realized proof.
definitions.stable_current_edge: A currently available account-qualified positive after-all-cost mechanism with demonstrated recurrence and no unresolved time-limited or material program-rate dependency.
definitions.standalone_incremental_cash: Positive incremental cash that does not require an independently profitable trade borrow loan conversion or authentic external user flow. It may still require independently already-held idle principal.
